time_mapping: time_full = time_body + 5; body time starts after warning; no legacy source offset or BPM grid applied

analysis.method: positive log spectral difference with 3-bin frequency maximum reference, 2-hop lag, three frequency bands, Gaussian smoothing, local median/MAD peak threshold, 40ms merge, 105ms refractory
analysis.confidence_semantics: algorithmic multi-band agreement and local peak salience, not a calibrated probability
analysis.strong_kick_gate: strong kick/combined additionally requires low normalized flux >=0.65 and low local-threshold ratio >=1.6; middle/high attacks alone cannot promote a camera kick
analysis.type_semantics: kick/snare/combined are mixed-audio frequency-band attack candidates; vocals/synths may also contribute; no isolated drum stems

limitations: No source separation and no manual per-beat listening confirmation.
Not lyric/phoneme alignment, tempo transcription or a claim every event is a drum.
Mono analysis can miss anti-phase stereo attacks; only analysis audio was downsampled.
Use strong/high kick or combined for restrained camera accents; other events are local light candidates.
Section gains are conservative visual recommendations, not automatic full-frame flashes.
